# Crafter Research

> Independent research lab in Lima, Peru. We publish preregistered measurements, data audits and open-source tools, with every number reproducible from public data.

## Khipu (quipu) research

Khipu, quipu and kipu are spellings of the same thing: the knotted cords of the Inka state.

- [Khipu (quipu) colours and numbers](https://crafter.ing/research/khipu-colour-legend): preregistered measurement of how much cord colour says about khipu numbers (0.016 bits per cord after controls), a recheck of the Santa Valley match, and an audit of the Open Khipu Repository 2.1.0.
- [Colores y números en los khipus (quipus)](https://crafter.ing/es/research/khipu-colour-legend): the same article in Spanish.
- [khipu-null](https://github.com/crafter-research/khipu-null): open-source CLI (`uvx khipu-null`, MIT, on PyPI) that ranks khipus against a YAML pattern and tests whether a match is chance with structure-preserving permutation nulls, a top-k test and Benjamini-Hochberg q-values.
- [Quipu analysis in Python notebook](https://github.com/crafter-research/khipu-null/blob/main/examples/quipu-analysis.ipynb) ([Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/github/crafter-research/khipu-null/blob/main/examples/quipu-analysis.ipynb), [Kaggle](https://www.kaggle.com/code/raillyhugo/analisis-de-quipus-khipus-en-python)): Spanish notebook, download the Open Khipu Repository, draw a khipu, rank quipus against a pattern, read p, q and the top-k test.
- [crafter-research/khipu](https://github.com/crafter-research/khipu): preregistrations, scripts, results and reviews behind the article.

### Questions khipu-null answers

- Which khipus (quipus) match a model? A score per khipu for the features in a YAML pattern.
- Which five quipus best represent it? `khipu-null rank ... --top 5` and its top-k test against null versions of every khipu.
- Is a correspondence a verifiable regularity or a coincidence? A permutation p and a Benjamini-Hochberg q per khipu.
- Works on any CSV with one row per cord, including Open Khipu Repository 2.1.0 exports with Spanish columns (codigo_kh, cuerda_uid, grupo_uid, posicion, nivel, color, valor). Mapping: [README](https://github.com/crafter-research/khipu-null#spanish-column-csvs).
